pkgmetadata.longdescription: DMD is the reference compiler for the D programming language. This package follows Arch Linux extra/dmd: the compiler is built from the dlang/dmd tag, and the Phobos standard library plus Druntime live in dev-libs/libphobos. Bootstrapping uses gdc from sys-devel/gcc with the D language enabled, wrapped by gdmd so that compiler/src/build.d can use dmd-style flags.
